logic.intent: 将余额变动累加到对应币种的账户余额
登记预留并立即扣减账户余额（防止预留期间超额支取）
logic.referenceCode: state.copy(accountBalance = updateAccountBalance(state, event.amount.currency, event.amount.copy(amount = -event.amount.amount)), reservedAmount = state.reservedAmount + (event.transferId -> event.amount))

logic.intent: 转账提交后移除该笔预留
转账回滚时释放该笔预留并回补账户余额
logic.referenceCode: state.copy(accountBalance = updateAccountBalance(state, event.amount.currency, event.amount), reservedAmount = state.reservedAmount - event.transferId)

logic.intent: 按转账 id 登记入账金额
入账提交后贷记账户余额并移除该笔入账记录
logic.referenceCode: state.copy(accountBalance = updateAccountBalance(state, state.incomingCredits(event.transferId).currency, state.incomingCredits(event.transferId)), incomingCredits = state.incomingCredits - event.transferId)

logic.intent: 入账取消时移除该笔入账记录

value.intent: 按币种键把 updateMoney 累加到账户余额（币种不一致视为零）
校验预留不重复、转账金额为正、且不超过该币种可用余额（transferAmount ≤ fromBalance）
value.referenceCode: if (reservedAmount.contains(transferId)) Left(DuplicateReservationError) else if (transferAmount.amount <= BigDecimal(0)) Left(InvalidTransferAmountError) else if (fromBalance.forall(_.amount < transferAmount.amount)) Left(InsufficientBalanceError) else Right(())
